This reverts commit 8f21c4a. The tuple-keyed cache retained
tuples of request args indefinitely when eviction could not keep
up, leaking memory on the /orders endpoint. Reverting while a
proper LRU lands separately.

Refs: #1483

revert: "fix(ui): remove stale Escape key listener on modal close"

This reverts commit 4b9e02d. The cleanup introduced a regression:
re-renders re-attached the handler because onClose changes identity
every render, doubling the effect churn. The original bug will be
fixed by stabilising onClose at the call sites instead.

This reverts commit 6c113ba. Consumers still read cart.items
directly throughout the checkout flow, and the partial migration
left remove() writing to the wrong path. Reverting wholesale until
all call sites move together.
